Class InventoryService

java.lang.Object
learn.inventory.service.InventoryService
public class InventoryService extends Object
Manages the application's in-memory inventory and its core product operations.

This service handles adding, finding, updating, and deleting products. It also coordinates saving and loading through an InventoryRepository.

The service depends on the repository interface rather than a specific storage implementation. This allows different repository implementations to be used without changing the inventory business logic.

  • Constructor Details

    • InventoryService

      public InventoryService()
      Creates an inventory service using the application's default file-based repository.

      Inventory data is saved to and loaded from data/inventory.txt.

    • InventoryService

      public InventoryService(InventoryRepository repository)
      Creates an inventory service using the supplied repository.

      This constructor allows the service to work with different storage implementations and makes the service easier to test.

      Parameters:
      repository - repository used to save and load inventory products

    • loadInventory

      public void loadInventory() throws IOException
      Loads products through the configured repository and replaces the current in-memory inventory.

      The file is loaded into a temporary list before the current inventory is cleared. This protects the existing inventory if loading fails.

      Throws:
      IOException - if the inventory cannot be read or contains invalid data

    • addProduct

      public boolean addProduct(Product product)
      Adds a product when the product is not null and its ID is not already in the inventory.
      Parameters:
      product - product to add
      Returns:
      true when the product is added; false when the product is null or its ID already exists

    • getAllProducts

      public List<Product> getAllProducts()
      Returns a copy of the current product list.

      Returning a copy prevents outside classes from directly modifying the service's internal inventory collection.

      Returns:
      a new list containing all current products

    • findProductById

      public Product findProductById(String productID)
      Searches for a product using its unique product ID.

      The search ignores capitalization and surrounding whitespace.

      Parameters:
      productID - product ID to search for
      Returns:
      the matching product, or null when no match is found

    • findProductsByName

      public List<Product> findProductsByName(String productName)
      Searches for products whose names contain the supplied search text.

      The search ignores capitalization and supports partial-name matches.

      Parameters:
      productName - full or partial product name to search for
      Returns:
      a list of matching products; the list is empty when no matches are found or the search value is blank

    • updateProduct

      public boolean updateProduct(String productID, int newQuantity, double newPrice)
      Updates the quantity and price of an existing product.

      The quantity is adjusted through the product's stock methods instead of changing its private quantity field directly.

      Parameters:
      productID - ID of the product to update
      newQuantity - new inventory quantity
      newPrice - new product price
      Returns:
      true when the product is updated; false when the product does not exist or either new value is negative

    • deleteProduct
